items.title: Xiaomi cars go on presale in UAE, with first deliveries due in December

items.title: Musk pledges to boost Tesla production in China
items.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company would continue increasing production in China during a meeting with China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Chairman Ren Hongbin in Shenzhen on Thursday. Musk, who was visiting the city for APEC-related events, also described himself as a “super fan” of China.

items.title: Meituan brings cable-lowering delivery drones to Dubai
items.summary: Meituan unveiled its M-Drone 4L delivery drone in Dubai on Wednesday, marking the model’s first overseas appearance. The aircraft hovers above a delivery point and lowers packages by cable.

items.title: DeepSeek drops separate fees for model-triggered web searches
items.summary: DeepSeek has removed separate charges for web searches, image searches and webpage fetching performed through its models’ built-in server-side tools. Developers now pay for the model tokens used during those interactions, including the material retrieved and processed. The change took effect on November 18.

items.title: Tencent cuts Yuanbao spending after AI app falls short of expectations
items.summary: Tencent has substantially reduced spending on its Yuanbao AI app after it failed to achieve the success the company initially expected, President Martin Lau said on Wednesday. Speaking on Tencent’s earnings call, Lau said Yuanbao’s focus had shifted from expanding its user base to improving its capabilities.

items.title: Game consoles and Teslas are slipping past OT network segmentation
items.summary: Claroty went looking for consumer gadgets on hospital, factory and commercial networks and found tens of thousands of them, from game consoles and Roku streaming sticks to Teslas. Roku sticks and smart watches mostly sat on guest networks, the separate segment meant for visitors’ devices.

items.title: What are data silos? Breaking down IT's visibility gap
items.summary: Data silos are where IT data gets locked up in isolated, disconnected systems, and you can't get a view across service management, security, and operations. They're the result of organizational boundaries, legacy tools, and poor data governance.
